copy_lock.copy:
This is the kind of love
I want us to grow into.

We will still get irritated
over keys, routes,
and very small things.

I will still say,
“Don’t talk to me.”

I hope we learn
that sometimes it means:
“Give me a minute.
Don’t go far.”

Not to fix it.
Just to notice
what it was really about.

And when the plan fails,
let’s still go on the date.
Even if it’s roadside chai.

You still checked the lock twice.
I still rolled my eyes.

Then I went back
and checked it with you.

visual_system_candidates.name: Cinematic Romance Blocking
visual_system_candidates.case_for: Protects eye-lines, hands, distance, and emotional reversal.
visual_system_candidates.risk: Can become too soft or abstract if the hook needs deadpan specificity.

why_it_wins: Cinematic Evidence Sequence wins because each image changes a visible relationship variable: direction, distance, gaze, occupied space, or shared action.
